title: Why Are Phone Charging Speeds Measured In Watts? - BGR
summary: However, having a massive 120W charging block doesn't guarantee your phone will actually charge at that speed. While watts reflect potential charging speed, you need the right combination of charger, cable, and device to actually get it.
